patches.new:
os.environ['RFS_CFG'] = '{"add": ["f_c5s", "v_rl", "v_fvb"]}'
os.environ['RFS_XDIRS'] = '/kaggle/input'   # FF runner (CHANGES.md): same value as the default root of rfs_train._xload; the runner rewrites this path to the stage's own input view
patches.why: the gzip+base64-embedded rfs_train.py (_xload, original/embedded/train/rfs_train.py) scans os.environ['RFS_XDIRS'] or else the literal /kaggle/input for the FACTOR-01 extra blocks; the runner's text rewrite cannot reach code decoded at run time. Setting RFS_XDIRS to the same literal in the parameter cell lets the runner's rewrite point it at the stage's own input view (the subprocesses inherit os.environ). On Kaggle the value equals the default root, so the behaviour of the original run is unchanged. Reached through load_extra for RFS_CFG add [f_c5s, v_rl, v_fvb] (rfs_train.py:521 / 547 / 565 / 707, mode P and selfcheck).
patches.effect_on_numbers: none (same files as the original run)

patches.old: torch.save({"params": [torch.zeros(2)]}, WORK / "lora_C1.pt")          # smoke: lora gia (luot L that chay tren Kaggle GPU)
patches.why: with FLAG_SMOKE=1 the original inputs cell writes a stand-in lora_C1.pt ({'params': [zeros(2)]}); mode P copies it into rfs_art/lora_C1.pt (stage_release, rfs_train.py:684), and the runner's variant check (configs/variant_1354.json file_checks: every lora_C1.pt of every output = b97372e3...) then stops every smoke run with VariantError. In mode P the file is only copied (shutil.copy + sha256 in the manifest), never loaded, so copying the mounted original C1 changes nothing else in smoke. Same patch as stage t163p_c5rl of group 40 (WP-F).
patches.effect_on_numbers: none (FLAG_SMOKE=1 path only; a real run never reaches this branch)
